prompt:
Add a `--retry <n>` flag to fetchcli.

- `Options.Parse` gains an `int Retry` property, default 0, set by `--retry <n>`. A negative n is an error, like any other bad argument.
- `Fetcher.RunAsync` retries the fetch up to `Retry` more times when the getter throws, so `--retry 2` means at most three attempts. The last exception propagates when every attempt fails.
- Update the usage line in Program.cs and the README.

Existing tests must keep passing. Add tests for the new behaviour in tests/FetchCli.Tests.
